rules.sentence: Tumors exhibiting 3 or more risk factors for recurrence are of particular concern.
Key risk factors for identifying high-risk individuals include the total number of SCCs, the frequency of new tumor formation, and the presence of aggressive tumor features.
Aggressive characteristics may include tumor invasion beyond the skin, perineural involvement, and large or poorly differentiated tumors.
These factors guide treatment decisions and help determine appropriate follow-up protocols.[11]
